timing_definitions.waypoint_planning_trigger: request events from retained task state machine, not an assumed fixed periodic task planner
timing_definitions.compute_ms: worker_start_ns to compute_finish_ns for every completed request, including dropped and failed
timing_definitions.control_cycle_miss: WallPhysicsSession.boundary grid gap; missed sensor/control grids divided by total elapsed 5ms grids
timing_definitions.longest_consecutive_miss: maximum single boundary grid gap minus one, reconstructed from control_poll catchup end grids
timing_definitions.request_counts: all lifecycle outcomes, no exclusion of dropped or stale requests
timing_definitions.stats: arithmetic mean, numpy percentile p95, maximum; all times in milliseconds

historical_tail.reproduction: attempt exact retained deployable snapshot if accessible; otherwise report historical only

same_semantics_equivalence.required_fields: candidate labels, feasibility, chosen action, waypoint, schedule, cost and safety checks

development_target.cycle_miss_ratio: must decrease relative to the paired baseline corpus

source_changes_allowed: implementation-preserving optimization only unless separately versioned as a new algorithm candidate
candidate_gate: fixed-snapshot equivalence before short closed-loop cases; final low-ROM23 and confirmed High-ROM fixed/variable matrices with unchanged task/safety/stale rules
